findings.title: remote Python package identity is not frozen
findings.evidence: The preflight binds the interpreter path and minimum version but not torch, torchvision, numpy, yaml, spikingjelly, timm or einops versions/build identities. The local dry run does not import the full profile/model stack.
findings.required_before_gpu_capture: During the sealed remote preflight, emit and independently seal sys.version plus package versions/build/CUDA identities, then import the frozen profile and record resolved module origins without constructing the model or touching CUDA.

findings.title: untracked import shadowing is not excluded
findings.evidence: Git HEAD/tree and selected tracked roots are checked, but untracked files are not rejected and resolved origins for configs, DSEC_dataloader, models and utils are not asserted. A repo-root untracked package can precede baseline/overlay paths.
findings.required_before_gpu_capture: Reject untracked files under import-visible runtime roots or explicitly assert and hash every resolved runtime module origin in remote preflight.

findings.title: post-capture summary uses advisory receipt names different from the literal runner receipt
findings.evidence: The contract and runner agree on launch_outer_seal_sha256 and capture_* fields, but capture_m460r3 writes summary.result_sealing.receipt_binding_required as summary_sha256, inner_manifest_sha256 and outer_seal_file_sha256.
findings.required_before_gpu_capture: Make the summary use the four literal contract/runner names, then refreeze contract/manifest/outer seal and obtain a delta hammer.

findings.title: frozen contract admission booleans are intentionally pre-seal stale
findings.evidence: admission.launch_manifest_created and outer_seal_created remain false even though the externally rooted artifacts now exist.
findings.recommendation: Keep as historical pre-review state or clarify in the later review receipt; do not mutate this frozen contract in place.

findings.title: queue receipt is outside the result double seal
findings.evidence: The payload is independently double-sealed and the queue receipt contains its hashes, but the receipt itself has no additional authenticated manifest.
findings.recommendation: Bind the queue receipt in a later reviewer seal after capture; this does not weaken the payload's inner/outer verification.

authorization.next_gate: Independently review the sealed remote preflight receipt and close P1-1/P1-2/P1-3 before any explicit-capture authorization.
